thread:
Aisha Patel: heads up — Aurora Therapeutics is blocking the pilot go/no-go. legal + infosec raised items: SSO/SCIM, eu data residency, pentest evidence, and an IP allowlist for the POC. buyer expects pricing concession. we need an internal escalation to close by EOD Wed. cc @Marco Ruiz @Priya Menon @Nora Blake

Marco Ruiz: got it. can someone drop the questionnaire link and deadline here?

Aisha Patel: deadline = EOD Wed (3 days). questionnaire: https://files.internal/aurora/sec-questionnaire-v2.docx

Priya Menon: quick read — key asks: 1) SAML SSO + SCIM provisioning 2) GDPR residency in eu-west-1 for PHI adjacency 3) SOC2 scope + recent pen test report 4) per-account data separation for the POC 5) IP allowlist for outbound callbacks. also they want sample SLA for latency.

Jin Park: product/security notes — per-account separation is achievable on Dedicated; hosted requires encryption + logical isolation (we can document controls). pentest report available (redacted) and I can push latest findings. attaching ref: https://redwood-internal/reports/pentest-2025.pdf

OpsBot: New ticket created: SEC-4821 — Aurora POC access & tenancy. assignee @Elena Schmidt.

Elena Schmidt: thanks. ops questions: expected concurrency? avg / max token lengths? runway for cluster sizing.

Aisha Patel: POC ask from Aurora: 10 concurrent seats, avg seq ~512 tokens, peak bursts to ~1500 tokens. POC length 6 weeks with a staged ramp over first 48h.

Marco Ruiz: buyer asked about pilot pricing — they want a locked pilot price for first year and a deeper pilot discount. sales suggests 30% pilot discount then standard committed pricing on renewal.

Carlos Vega: tagging Nora — i recommend approving 30% pilot discount + waive onboarding fee for the POC to avoid deal slipping. estimated ARR if converted ~ $1.2M. Nora, your call.

Nora Blake: approve 30% pilot discount and waive onboarding fee for this POC only. condition: security checklist closed and legal addendum signed before access. log decision in SF.

Priya Menon: for SSO/SCIM implementation, we need their IdP SAML metadata and SCIM base URL. sample SAML attributes we will consume:
```
NameID: urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress
Attributes:
  - email (user.email)
  - givenName (user.firstName)
  - familyName (user.lastName)
  - groups (user.groups)
  - employeeNumber (user.id)
```
Provide metadata file and we can do an IdP test within 48h after addendum signed.

Jin Park: legal/infosec needs to confirm data residency design. proposed approach: spin dedicated pool in eu-west-1 with customer-managed KMS. that satisfies GDPR + their compliance team. legal, can you draft quick addendum for Dedicated POC?

LegalBot: Legal assigned: LGAL-1294 — Aurora POC addendum. priority: high. estimated turnaround: 48 hours (subject to redlines).

Elena Schmidt: ops actionables: (1) reserve 1 x small-dedicated-pool (2) create tenancy + encrypt with customer KMS (3) configure IP allowlist once we get their egress ranges. ETA: 72h after signed addendum.

Marco Ruiz: buyer also asked for a pen-test attestation and SOC2 in-scope evidence. Jin, you said the report is available — can we get a customer-facing attestation doc?

Jin Park: yes — I'll pull a customer-friendly attestation and the SOC2 summary. expect docs by EOD tomorrow.

Aisha Patel: i'm collecting their IP ranges and IdP metadata — will post in this thread as soon as I have it. also scheduling a 30-min exec sync with Aurora's CTO for Tue morning to remove blockers.

Carlos Vega: FYI i'll prep a short term sheet reflecting the pilot discount + 3-month min commit for Dedicated if they want to convert early. sending to legal for review.

Priya Menon: quick note on monitoring/tracing during POC — we should enable per-route latency dashboards and token-level cost reporting for Aurora. Ops, can you add a temporary dashboard and grant Aurora read-only access?

Elena Schmidt: yes — we can create a read-only console view scoped to their tenant once the tenancy exists. will include traces and token cost breakdown.

Aisha Patel: summary of action items (owners):
- Legal addendum draft (LegalBot / LGAL-1294) — 48h (Jin to follow up)
- Pentest attestation + SOC2 summary (Jin Park) — EOD tomorrow
- Reserve Dedicated pool + KMS config (Elena Schmidt) — 72h after addendum
- Collect IdP metadata + IP ranges (Aisha Patel) — today/Tue
- Pricing term sheet w/ pilot concession (Carlos Vega) — today
- Exec sync with Aurora CTO (Aisha) — Tue AM

Marco Ruiz: +1 on action items. tagging @Nora Blake for visibility.

Nora Blake: thanks team — keep me posted if anything slips past the Wed deadline. I'm available for a quick exec call if legal needs support.

Aisha Patel: thanks all. i'll update thread as items close. :pray:

Marco Ruiz: thumbs up :thumbsup:

LegalBot: LGAL-1294 status updated -> In progress (48h).

Elena Schmidt: created infra ticket OPS-9073 for dedicated pool prep. will update once tenancy provisioned.

Aisha Patel: (late note) buyer asked for a short live demo of SSO + sample workload before POC start. Priya, can you lead the demo Wed afternoon?

Priya Menon: yes — can do Wed 3pm UTC. will prepare a slim demo script and test IdP.

Marco Ruiz: perfect. closing for now — will reopen if blockers appear.

Priya Menon: closing checklist: all docs + addendum must be signed before we hand over credentials.

Aisha Patel: last update: sent follow-up to Aurora for IdP metadata and IP ranges (email sent).

Elena Schmidt: noted. standing by.
